purpose: Canonical full-replay 2^3 causal factorial of the remaining mode-20 to mode-21 delta after Matrices 32-34 eliminated the other camera-guard branches.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Modes 28-34 inherited mode 20 and toggled only A=unmasked camera motion in repetition qualification, B=mode-21 risk/state restoration semantics plus 0.40 s qualified risk lifetime, and C=mode-21 0.40 s signed-prime lifetime; mode 21 was the positive control.
interpretation: Factor B is the first clean causal discriminator for the mode-21 pan repair: every factorial candidate containing B passed the <0.030 extreme-pan gate (~0.0134-0.0135), while every candidate without B failed (~0.0656-0.0673). A and C are neither necessary nor sufficient. B still misses the weak/perceptual target, and the mathematically unchanged mode-20 control shifted from a 0.4140 perceptual floor in Matrix 34 to 0.1605 in Matrix 35. Matrix 36 therefore repeats identical mode-20/B controls in one binary and decomposes B into sequence-conditioned state semantics versus the 0.40 s risk lifetime before any new safety architecture is attempted.
